name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mmph... mmmph mmmph...」
During practice combat against Asahi―chan―

name: Asahi
message: 「...I’m ready whenever you are, Setsugekka-san.」
Asahi-chan says that, but while facing her, I’m at a loss...

name: Setsugekka
message: （I have no idea how I’m supposed to attack her...！）
Truth be told, this is my third round of practice combat with Asahi-chan.
And so far... I’ve lost twice. And it was a total rout, too.

name: Setsugekka
message: （I can’t win unless I get into close quarters... but that reach of hers...）
The first time, I rushed in blindly and got countered as you’d expect.
The second time, I tried throwing out various feints at the very edge of her reach, only for Asahi-chan to step in and slash me.
Attacking doesn't work, waiting doesn't work, feinting doesn't work—this is impossible！

name: Setsugekka
message: （No, wait, if I don’t overcome this, I won’t even be able to take down Momimomi！）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’ve got no choice but to do this...！」
With desperate resolve, I kick off the ground and dive toward Asahi-chan.
Though, it’s not just a blind rush. I’m aiming for a counter！

name: Asahi
message: 「Hmph...！」
The moment I entered blade range, Asahi-chan whipped her weapon around in a sharp sweep.
But I saw that coming. I block the attack with my gauntlet and force my way in！
And as Asahi-chan tries to create some distance, I dash after her again！
Advancing is faster than retreating, so I catch up to Asahi―chan just like that―

name: Setsugekka
message: 「This time for sure—take this！」
The fist I unleashed finally lands on Asahi-chan！
Asahi―chan is braced with her right shoulder pushed forward, taking the brunt of my punch―
...Taking it？

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m afraid it won’t work.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way！？ I landed the hit but did zero damage！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Oosode Myouga—simply put, it’s like unfolding my Barrier Jacket into a harder, thicker state to create actual armor.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Asahi-chan, you learned how to do that！？」
No, wait, it doesn't matter！ I'm hitting her, so if I just push through with pure strength—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Guh, nnngh...！ Gnuuuuugh...！！ She isn’t even budging an inch...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「If it's a contest of strength, I feel even less like I'll lose」
That's right, Asahi-chan is incredibly strong, after all...！
That's why those Iai draws of hers are so heavy...

name: Setsugekka
message: （Ah, that's right, Iai...！！）
Before I knew it, Asahi-chan's Origami had been sheathed.
Her current stance, with her right shoulder thrust forward, is also an Iai form when you look closely.

name: Setsugekka
message: （Crap――）
By the time I thought that, it was too late.
Because Asahi-chan twisted her waist to draw her blade, I had my balance broken as if I were being parried.
The rest is a sight I've become all too familiar with...

name: Asahi
message: 「It's over！」
The moment after I thought how beautiful the trajectory of the glittering blade was, I found myself staring at the sky, sprawled on the ground...！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uuugh, I lost again！ Sensei, what should I do！」
After finishing practice――
Setsugekka-san gets up and runs over to Iori-san with teary eyes.

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm. There are a lot of things we should work on, I suppose.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then please work on all of them！」
I watch that exchange from afar while wiping away my sweat.

name: Asahi
message: （Setsugekka-san... she barely loses control anymore, and her physique is gradually getting stronger...）
Even from my perspective, I can see she's growing. That makes me feel envious... and also afraid.

name: Asahi
message: （...No, I won't lose either. She is certainly getting stronger, but the same goes for me. After all, I'm being trained by Iori-san！）
I've managed to incorporate into actual combat my style of fighting that uses feints to take the initiative, as well as the 'Ousode Myouga' I devised while consulting with Iori-san.

name: Asahi
message: （If things go at this rate, Setsugekka-san shouldn't be a threat. The problem is more...）
I can't help but remember the time I lost to Tennouji-senpai.
I suppose it can't be helped, as she is the current Toujinegi. But if I can't defeat her, the path to becoming a Toujinegi will not open for me.
And if it comes to the Martial Festival, she will surely face me in perfect form, in even better condition than she was then.

name: Asahi
message: （The path to becoming a Toujinegi still seems far off...）
I knew all of that from the very beginning. I can't give up. Not ever.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, then let's head back and take a break for now. Asahi, let's call it a day for you too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...No, Iori-sensei. I'm going to do some independent training.」

name: Iori
message: 「You just finished practice, so you should rest your body a bit.」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, I'm fine. If this much is enough to wear me out, then becoming the Toujinegi is nothing more than a distant dream.」
With those words—I left that place alone.
